purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and schema-first anonymous geometry review.
assessment: The official Jalpaiguri district portal identifies Land Records as a citizen-service route; the district NIC page describes West Bengal eBhuchitra as the Land & Land Reforms Department G2C system for mutation/conversion and digitally signed record-of-rights, and Banglarbhumi as the portal for record-of-rights and plot information. These are land-record pathways but no Jalpaiguri urban parcel geometry schema or point-specific map coverage was verified. Official district sources route to West Bengal land-record systems, but no anonymous city parcel-vector endpoint and safe field schema were identified. The district’s public map page lists administrative/district/block maps, not parcel polygons; no plot-level query was submitted.
